dates_and_calendars.is_working_day

Checks if the date is a working day or not for any of the calendars or currencies provided.

Available as lseg.data.dates_and_calendars.is_working_day.

is_working_day(
    date: OptDateTime = None,
    currencies: list[str] | None = None,
    calendars: list[str] | None = None,
) -> bool

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
date OptDateTime No None Particular date to check.
currencies list[str] | None No None Currencies to use for calculation of the date for the working day or weekend. Optional if calendars is provided.
calendars list[str] | None No None Calendars to use the date for the working day or weekend. Optional if currencies is provided.

Returns

bool

If requested day is working day returns True, otherwise returns False

Example

import datetime
import lseg.data as ld

ld.open_session("platform.default")

is_working = ld.dates_and_calendars.is_working_day(
   date=datetime.datetime(2020, 7, 10),
   currencies=["EUR"]
)
